assertion_analysis.failure_condition: assert_identity compares all seven receipt fields of the installed build against the same fields rebuilt from revision 511a22e06^ (the pre-repair source loaded as an independent module); a change to any receipt field in nova/equilibrium/contour_tree.py reddens it.
fail if the sweep stops visiting each vertex; vertex_count is taken from the input size, not from the instrument, so the two sides are independent.
fail if the parent structure the sweep builds exceeds ceil(log2(vertex_count))+1 hops; reinstating the pre-repair merge (shadow negative control) reddens it at 52 > 15.

findings.text: follow-on: when REFERENCE_CONTOUR_TREE_MODULE is unset the identity guard's only fallback is a hard-coded `git show 511a22e06^:nova/equilibrium/contour_tree.py` subprocess, so in a shallow clone or any tree lacking that commit the new default-lane guard errors during collection instead of skipping; the guard then reports a red on the very lane this node exists to serve, for a reason unrelated to the code under test.

follow-on: the depth test feeds the sweep unsigned `jnp.asarray(vertex_psi)` while the profile module it imports measures on the sigma-signed flux (scripts/prototypes/contour_tree_sweep_profile/profile.py:205), so the two measured sweep directions do not reproduce the inputs the profiling baseline recorded; the rank-balanced bound holds for any order or sign, so this is a fidelity gap rather than a wrong assertion.

item_verdicts.diff: One commit c22f2d1e5 adds tests/test_contour_tree_sweep_bounds.py (118 lines) and the 16-line evidence fragment; the diff contains no production-code change and stays inside the declared write paths.
item_verdicts.done_when: The done_when (brief.txt:7) requires a fresh CPU pytest pass, a default collect-only line, and a literal negative control that reddens the depth assertion; logs/head-cpu-gate.log records 2 passed EXIT=0 under JAX_PLATFORMS=cpu, logs/default-collect.log lists both tests at 7953/8956, and logs/negative-control-retry.log fails on the bound assertion at 52 > 15 with EXIT=1.
item_verdicts.goal: The source brief.txt dispatches a single default-lane file that carries the contour-tree receipt-identity guard and the missing root-hop depth guard; tests/test_contour_tree_sweep_bounds.py:56 and :86 add exactly those two, the second reading depth through the profile's existing counter (scripts/prototypes/contour_tree_sweep_profile/profile.py:141) rather than a new instrument.
item_verdicts.manifest: Read; manifest.md records commit c22f2d1e5, both changed paths, the head gate result, the negative control and its log, and status complete, though its baseline_suite and after_suite lines are empty and its negative-control note names the mutation as a root-lookup change when the shadow reinstates the whole pre-repair merge.
item_verdicts.write_paths: The manifest declares tests/test_contour_tree_sweep_bounds.py and docs/evidence/fragments/converged-forward-solve/contour-tree-guards-in-lane.html; the single commit c22f2d1e5 changes exactly those two paths and nothing else.

justifications.durability: tests/test_contour_tree_sweep_bounds.py:110 fails when the pre-repair union-find merge is reinstated (shadow control: 52 > 15), and :80 fails if any of the seven receipt fields regresses, both against sources independent of the code under test.
justifications.evidence: logs/head-cpu-gate.log's summary line records 2 passed in 160.41 s with EXIT=0, logs/default-collect.log records both tests collected at 7953/8956, and logs/negative-control-retry.log records the pre-repair walk failing the bound at 52 > 15 with EXIT=1.
justifications.fit: tests/test_contour_tree_sweep_bounds.py:1-29 follows the prototype guards' idiom and imports their helpers, and introduces no plan, ticket or version token in any name or docstring.
justifications.goal_fidelity: tests/test_contour_tree_sweep_bounds.py:56 asserts all seven receipt fields against a separately loaded revision and :110 asserts the join and split sweeps stay within ceil(log2(vertex_count))+1, matching the two guards the brief.txt asks for in the default lane.
justifications.reuse: assert_identity, inputs, instrumented_sweep and load_builder are imported from scripts/prototypes/contour_tree_sweep_profile/profile.py and the fixtures from benchmarks/contour_tree_brute_force.py rather than re-implemented, so the depth counter is the profile's own instrument.
justifications.scope_discipline: git diff bd4f94220..c22f2d1e5 changes only tests/test_contour_tree_sweep_bounds.py and docs/evidence/fragments/converged-forward-solve/contour-tree-guards-in-lane.html, both inside the manifest's declared write paths.
